centurion5_2dk.name: Centurion Mk 5/2 DK
centurion5_2dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Centurion Mk 5/2 DK at tier III, the Centurion Mk 5/2's build with the Danish 1985 fire-control fit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
centurion5_2dk.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope, the Centurion Mk 5/2's (published 9.83 m over the gun, 3.38 m wide with skirts). The 1985 Danish fit (the laser rangefinder's armoured box on the mantlet's right, the gunner's thermal sight box on the roof's right front, image intensifiers) sits inside it, as armyvehicles.dk's photograph of the Oksbøl tank (Henrik Clausen) shows.
